2.209.13
Map.MapDataRegions
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.MapDataRegions element specifies a collection of MapDataRegion elements for a Map. The
Map.MapDataRegions element is optional. This element is of type MapDataRegions.
The following is the parent element of the Map.MapDataRegions element.
Parent elements
 Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.MapDataRegions element.
 <xsd:element name="MapDataRegions" type="MapDataRegionsType" minOccurs="0" />
